title: Proceedings of the United Nations/Germany Workshop on the International Space Weather Initiative
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: This open access book presents peer reviewed articles from the United Nations/Germany Workshop on International Space Weather Initiative (ISWI 2024) held from 10 to 15 June at Neustrelitz, Germany. It highlights the current status of global space weather research, especially in developing countries. The topics of the workshop cover the entire Sun Earth system starting from the Sun where most space weather originates and the impact at various points in the inner heliosphere including those on Earth’s surface.
